The paper shares embedding and head weights; the checkpoint also stores named tensors of the same shapes. These are not treated as new backbone layers.
Counting serialized entries gives 684,489,845,504 in total (excluding FP8 scales). Full tensor values were not read to test whether copies are equal.

Replacing 256 routed experts with 8 and counting the full embedding table gives 37,552,297,472; counting only the looked-up embedding row while retaining the full LM head gives 36,625,625,600 ≈37B. The paper reports an approximation without an itemized ledger.
Excluding 14,848 non-gradient routing correction values gives 671,026,404,352 gradient-trained backbone parameters.
